title: The missing field recorder
question: Who last handled KIT-17 at the media returns desk?

reports.name: Incident report
reports.text: On 18 September, staff found field recorder KIT-17 missing at 15:30. The records under review cover the 15:00 to 15:15 handover at the media returns desk.

reports.name: Equipment checkout log
reports.text: At 15:06, Dev Rao [P102] checked out KIT-17 at the media returns desk.

reports.name: Handover note
reports.text: At 15:12, D. Rao [P104] received KIT-17 at the media returns desk.

reports.name: Witness account
reports.text: At 15:10, Mira Sen [P101] reportedly received KIT-17 at the media returns desk.

reports.name: Shift register
reports.text: From 15:00 to 15:20, Mira Sen [P101] was logged at the east reception desk.
